Canonical removal targets are held in the weak registry independently of mutable public metadata; changed getters run at the native deletion stage.

native_dispatch_followup.root_cause: The earlier controls covered a single listener. Native EventEmitter single dispatch reads .apply, but array dispatch invokes each function intrinsically. once uses .call for zero arguments and .apply otherwise. Unconditional callback .apply changes array dispatch and zero-argument once behavior.
native_dispatch_followup.structural_fix: Keep one observed invocation boundary. The on recording wrapper delegates direct function calls intrinsically and owns an .apply forwarding method for native method-based dispatch. Node selects which route executes; the hook neither reads nor copies listener storage. once selects native call/apply semantics by its actual argument count. handle remains intrinsic.
